purpose: Size the Fan_SMC_Pin_3 amplifier using the permitted parameters. Meet all eight fixed nominal DC, AC, and transient requirements within 30 evaluations. The joint requirements are project-defined for this released circuit adaptation.

paper.title: Single Miller Capacitor Frequency Compensation Technique for Low-Power Multistage Amplifiers

design_context.circuit_description: One Miller capacitor from first-stage output net050 to VOUT; separate feedforward PMOS drives output. Not the two-stage simple Miller topology also abbreviated SMC. Original uses 0.5um CMOS, +/-1V supply (2V rail span), 120pF parallel 25kohm; release uses SKY130 and CLOAD=10pF.
